title: Dollhouse Scale 1:12 Bathroom Sink Cabinet
author: mini.maker
description:
Dollhouse scale 1:12 Bathroom sink cabinet inspired by Ikea. Print with tree supports and they are easy to remove.   I print the sink separate from the base and drawer as I printed the sink at a .12 layer height and added ironing top layers for a smoother look.  I also added a variation of the knobs so on the “flat” version you don' t have to add supports.

Enjoy!
